label.explanation: A auth-svc reconciler session opened transaction 85871 on accounts-db and left it open holding a row lock on accounts (line 199). Subsequent updates queued behind that lock (lines 205, 214), so auth-svc's queries hit their statement timeout and account-svc's calls to auth-svc timed out (lines 210, 211, 218, 219, 221, 222). account-svc's connection pool to auth-svc saturating (lines 223, 235, 247) and the edge-proxy 504s (lines 233, 239, 249, 257, 264, 274, 284) are downstream symptoms. The fix is to kill the idle-in-transaction session, not to add capacity. Red herrings: line 72 (a client sending one invalid request, rejected correctly with a 400).
